content: Pungpah alawngnah bia
Kenkhria khua khrisawbu chung letei rai a hrepaw ka sateino Foibi heh naaning kha a hnithuisah heh ka du.

Khazing cawngsaw khatah a tlahpaw hratah naaning tah ama cawh Abuipaw ming tah za cyhlang la, bong a hianah maikaw lekhei za bong my lo, zecawtamaw tatah cawngsaw ahlupui khah bawkhang he ka, kama zong a pa bawkhang hrah.
Prisila le Akuila khah a dang pawtah pa tah pah my lo. Aaning cawh Khri Zisu rai letah ka raihrehui cang he ka,
ka cawtah thih hmai a ngangpaw a cang he. Aa cung letah ka lung a lawng. Kama long cang lytah Gental khrisawbu vytei zong a lawng hrah he.
Aa ing letei a pungpaw khrisawbu zong khah a dang pawtah pa tah pah my lo. Ka vesaw dopaw Epinita zong a dang pawtah pa tah pah my lo. Ama cawh Asia raang letah Khri a zing taw caipaw a cang.
Naa cawtah raihrang a hrepaw Mari khah a dang pawtah pa tah pah my lo.

Andrinika le Junia khah a dang pawtah pa tah pah my lo. Aaning cawh ka Juda mingphing hui, kama kha thong a tlah hruipaw a cang he. Aaning cawh apostol sahlo hrong letah hmezawpaw cang he ka, kama hlai tah khrisaw a cang ciapaw a cang he.
Abuipaw letei ka dopaw Ampliata khah a dang pawtah pa tah pah my lo.
Khri rai ka hrehruipaw Urbana le ka dopaw vesaw Stakhi khah a dang pawtah pa tah pah my lo.
Khri zingnah letah a se ngeteipaw Apele khah a dang pawtah pa tah pah my lo. Aristobula ingchungkho khah a dang pawtah pa tah pah my lo.
Ka mingphing hui Herodion le Narsisa ingchungkho letei khrisaw ka uny sahlo khah, a dang pawtah pa tah pah my lo.
Abuipaw rai a hrepaw Traifena le Traifosa khah a dang pawtah pa tah pah my lo. Abuipaw cawtah raisah a hrepaw ka dopaw vesaw Persi khah a dang pawtah pa tah pah my lo.
Abuipaw thingpaw Rufa le a no, sawtei hratah a pa mingkai pariapaw he khah a dang pawtah pa tah pah my lo.
Asinkrita, Flekon, Hermi, Patroba, Herma le aaning kha a ungpaw khrisaw uny vytei khah a dang pawtah pa tah pah my lo.
Filoloka le Julia, taico Nereus le a sateino le Olimpa le aaning kha a ungpaw mehpathai vytei khah a dang pawtah pa tah pah my lo.
Naaning cawh pakheh le pakheh a pathaipaw a doná tah bia a ching cy my lo. Khri tei a cangpaw khrisawbu vytei tah a dang pawtah aa ca tah he.
Uny sahlo, a pachainah a chuasah tu le naa zingnah hna a hnawh sahtu, naaning tei naa hmuh ciapaw cawngpahnah khatei a cakahpaw sahlo khah a raering la, tah ka ca pasy he. Aaning cawh cahri my lo.

Zecawtamaw tatah ma hapaw rai a hrepaw he cawh kaa Buipaw Khri rai aa hrepaw khah cang lytah aaning aa dunah cawtah aa tuapaw a cang hri. Aa hmokaw chaw le male hluihlang thai ná tah ningkheh teitah a ungpaw thaikhehpaw sahlo khah aa lung pamo he ka, aa dungkhei he.

Abuipaw a bia naa ngepaw khah ming maikaw tah thui he ka, ma kong lehei ka lung a lawng. Chahnah lang leco mehsing cang la, tah heh ka du, canghrasala chianah lang leco nyheh hasaitei hratah cang my lo, tah heh ka du.
Denah Khazing taco Setan khah naa pherai letah a ria pating a. Kaa Buipaw Zisu ningdonah cawh naaning khatah ung ky seh.
Ka raihrehui Timote tah a dang pawtah a ca tah he. Taico ka sawny a cangpaw he Lusia, Jason le Sosipater zong tah a dang pawtah aa ca tah he.
Ma cakua a ciapaw kama Tertia tah Abuipaw ming tah a dang pawtah ka ca tah he.
Ka tlungingpaw Kaia, khrisawbu a pungnah pawhe ing a hnuitu tah a dang pawtah a ca tah he. Ma khua tangka a kaitu Erasta le kaa unypaw Kuarta tah a dang pawtah aa ca tah he.
Kaa Buipaw Zisu Khri ningdonah cawh naa zongmingtei cung letah ung ky seh. Amen.
Ka reipaw Zisu Khri kong thawngchaw le khuahlai chai hlupui chung a nawhpaw biaparuh khah reichua a cangpaw hratah Khazing taco naa zingnah lekhei cy teitah a ca dawsah khy he a.

Atoheh cawh ma biahmuisui khah Khazing khuavang sahlo tei aa za ciapaw hrakhei reichua cang ca ka, chaizaw Khazing biapeh hratah ming vytei tah zing tah aa nge khy nápawtah mingphing vytei hai letah rei a cang myca.
Ama suipaw Khazing cang ka, Ama suipaw a sing hmuisuipaw a cang. Zisu Khri thongtah Khazing cawh chaizaw tah chaizaw tai reithai tah ung ky seh. Amen.
